target.title: Keep workspace suggestions opt-in for doctor lint
target.body:
## Summary
- mark `core/doctor/workspace-suggestions` default-disabled so default `doctor --lint` stays focused on actionable config/runtime problems
- keep the advisory workspace backup and memory-system suggestions available through `--only core/doctor/workspace-suggestions` or `--all`
- add selection coverage proving default lint skips the advisory check while explicit selection still reports info findings

## Public surface
- No public SDK/plugin/config contract changes.
- Default `doctor --lint` changes only by omitting this advisory `info` check; `--all` and `--only` still include it.

## PR surface
- 2 files changed, +53/-0 from `main`.

## Validation
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.test.ts` (78 tests)
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check`

## Real behavior proof
- GitHub Actions `Real behavior proof` passed on the updated head `13f50ef9b73061f23b12992cb18ce9775b9e8d10`:
  https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28692008105/job/85094905334
- This is a type-only fix; runtime selection behavior is unchanged from the proof already covered by the passing check.
